That fix position argues, from decompiled Microsoft.Data.Sqlite 10.0.9 and Fisher 1.27.0, that Error 5 is not the finalizer-deferred command leak 66cb565d fixed: SqliteConnection.CreateFunction (called by Weasel\\u0027s SqliteDataSource.applyExtensionsAndFunctions on open) refuses only while the same connection has a statement mid-run, and SqliteConnectionPool.ReclaimLeakedConnections returns a connection to the pool when its outer SqliteConnection was collected unclosed, possibly mid-read. So look for a connection, session, or reader abandoned undisposed. Treat that analysis as a lead to verify, not a finding. Work from origin/main after 66cb565d merges; its HomeStore and FinalizerHold are the tools to reuse. Non-goals: no upstream Fisher or Weasel change (a workaround in this repo is fine, and the pull request may name an upstream issue to file); no change to RecordExportTests or StoreDisposalTests beyond what a named cause needs; no new test infrastructure beyond what deterministic reproduction needs; no CI configuration change.
